name: DevBrothers Admin Panel
author: DevBrothers

sections.description:
DevBrothers Admin Panel is a base plugin for managing the DevBrothers plugin ecosystem. It provides:

  • Single access point to all DevBrothers plugins
  • Beautiful and intuitive interface
  • Centralized settings management
  • Information dashboard with statistics
  • Automatic integration with other DevBrothers plugins

External services

This plugin integrates with Google Translate service when the “DevBrothers Simple Translator” plugin is installed and active. This integration enables language switching functionality in the admin panel header.

The plugin loads the Google Translate JavaScript library from translate.google.com when the Simple Translator plugin is active. This is used to provide real-time translation of the WordPress admin interface.

The following data is sent to Google Translate:
* The page content when a user selects a different language in the admin panel header
* The selected language preference

This service is provided by Google LLC: Terms of Service (https://policies.google.com/terms), Privacy Policy (https://policies.google.com/privacy).

Note: This external service is only used when the “DevBrothers Simple Translator” plugin is installed and active. If the plugin is not installed, no data is sent to Google Translate.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the devbrothers-admin-panel folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to the ‘DevBrothers’ menu to access the admin panel
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

This plugin creates a centralized admin panel for all DevBrothers plugins, simplifying navigation and configuration.

Is this plugin required for other DevBrothers plugins to work?

Yes, all DevBrothers plugins require DevBrothers Admin Panel to be installed for proper operation. The plugin automatically detects and integrates installed DevBrothers plugins.

What DevBrothers plugins are available?

Current plugins in the DevBrothers ecosystem:
– DevBrothers Cyrillic URL – automatic transliteration of Cyrillic URLs
– DevBrothers Simple Translator – instant website translation via Google Translate
– Other plugins in development
